SELECT cam.id, cam.mec_id, cam.`name`, cam.mgr_name, cam.mgr_phone, cam.is_member, IF(cls.class_count IS NULL, 0, cls.class_count) class_count, IF(stu.student_count IS NULL, 0, stu.student_count) student_count, IF(tea.teacher_count IS NULL, 0, tea.teacher_count) teacher_count, IF(cou.course_count IS NULL, 0, cou.course_count) course_count, FROM bd_campus cam
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count(id) class_count, campus_id FROM bd_class WHERE is_delete = 0 AND class_state = 0 GROUP BY campus_id ) cls ON cam.id = cls.campus_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count(id) student_count, campus_id FROM bd_student WHERE is_delete = 0 AND is_ordinary = 0 GROUP BY campus_id ) stu ON cam.id = stu.campus_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count(id) teacher_count, campus_id FROM bd_teacher WHERE is_delete = 0 AND is_departure = 0 GROUP BY campus_id ) tea ON cam.id = tea.campus_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT count(id) course_count, campus_id FROM bd_course WHERE is_delete = 0 AND is_shelf = 1 GROUP BY campus_id ) cou ON cam.id = cou.campus_id WHERE cam.mec_id = #{mecId} and cam.is_delete = 0
AND cam.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name} ,'%')
AND cam.mgr_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mgrName} ,'%')
AND cam.mgr_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mgrPhone} ,'%')
GROUP BY cam.id

SELECT cam.`id`, cam.`name`, cam.`address`, cam.`mec_id` ,cam.`province`, cam.`city`, cam.`mgr_name`, cam.`mgr_phone`,cam.`mgr_contact_number`, cam.`latitude`, cam.`latitude`, cam.`is_member`, cam.`member_end_time`, cam.`is_delete`, cam.`create_time` , cam.`create_by` , cam.`update_time` , cam.`update_by`, su.nick_name create_by_name FROM bd_campus cam LEFT JOIN sys_user su on cam.create_by = su.user_id WHERE is_delete = 0 AND mec_id = #{mecId}
AND cam.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name} ,'%')
AND cam.mgr_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mgrName} ,'%')
AND cam.mgr_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mgrPhone} ,'%')
AND su.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{createByName} ,'%')
ORDER BY cam.`create_time` DESC
, cam.id DESC

SELECT cam.`id`, cam.`name`, cam.`address`, cam.`mec_id` ,cam.`province`, cam.`city`, cam.`mgr_name`, cam.`mgr_phone`,cam.`mgr_contact_number`, cam.`latitude`, cam.`latitude`, cam.`is_member`, cam.`member_end_time`, cam.`is_delete`, cam.`create_time` , cam.`create_by` , cam.`update_time` , cam.`update_by`, su.nick_name create_by_name, mec.name mec_name FROM bd_campus cam LEFT JOIN sys_user su on cam.create_by = su.user_id LEFT JOIN bd_mechanism mec on cam.mec_id = mec.id WHERE cam.is_delete = 0 AND cam.id = #{id}
